name: events-mt
description: Find events listed on Events.mt in Malta: programme, venue, ticket prices and availability.

interface.longDescription:
Events.lc looks up the events listed on its ticketing and event platform, starting with Malta at events.com.mt (Events.mt): search by words, dates or town, open an event to see its programme, start and end times (Malta local time), venue with address and map position, organiser, and the kinds of ticket with their prices, and check whether tickets are still on sale and how many places are left. You can also list the venues events are held at.

Everything the app shows is already public on events.com.mt, and no account is needed. It does not sell tickets: each result links to the event's page on events.com.mt, where tickets are bought from the organiser. Events by invitation appear only when their organiser lists them publicly; they are marked as such and cannot be booked without an invitation.
defaultPrompt: What events are listed at the Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre?
Tell me about the Malta Blockchain Summit 2018: where was it and what did passes cost?
What events are coming up on Events.mt?

positive.prompt: What events are listed at the Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre on Events.mt?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the public events held at the Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre (MFCC) in Ta' Qali, including the Careers Convention on 24 November 2017 and SiGMA'17 on 23 November 2017, each with its start time in Malta local time, the organiser (SiGMA) and a link to its page on events.com.mt.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the Malta Blockchain Summit 2018 on Events.mt: where and when was it held, and what did passes cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the event (slug blockchain) and reports that it ran from 1 November 2018 09:00 to 2 November 2018 21:00 (Malta time) at The InterContinental Arena in St. Julian's, organised by SiGMA, with Delegate, Affiliate and Blockchain Developer passes at EUR 399.00 each, and gives the link to its page.

positive.prompt: Can I still get tickets for the Walkathon on Events.mt, and how much were they?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the Walkathon (15 May 2016) has already taken place and its tickets are no longer on sale, and lists its two kinds of ticket: the 5 km walk from Spinola Bay at EUR 5.00 and the 8 km run from Pembroke at EUR 10.00.

positive.prompt: Which venues in Valletta have hosted events listed on Events.mt?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the venues in Valletta, such as The Grand Masters Palace, Casino Maltese and the Valletta Waterfront, with their addresses and map positions where known.

positive.prompt: Can I book a place at Where Business Meets Innovation on Events.mt?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Where Business Meets Innovation by Merlin Computers (29 October 2026 at 08:30, Malta local time, at the Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre in Ta' Qali) and explains that attendance is by invitation: it cannot be booked, and invited companies register their guests through the link in their invitation email. Gives the link to the event's page. No prices or places are given, and no guest or invitation details.

negative.description: Buying tickets is not supported in the app
negative.prompt: Buy two Delegate passes for the next Malta Blockchain Summit for me.

negative.description: Attendees' personal details are not provided
negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of the people who went to the Walkathon.
Book a table for four for dinner in Sliema tonight.

review.commerce_description: Events.lc does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. Results link to each event's page on events.com.mt, where tickets are bought from the event's organiser.

publication.release_notes: Events.lc for ChatGPT: search the events listed on events.com.mt in Malta (including events by invitation that their organiser lists publicly), see an event's programme, times, venue, organiser and ticket prices, check whether tickets are still available, and list event venues.
